scenes.big: The line that stops AI workflows breaking
scenes.say: Most AI workflows break on one thing: the model's answer isn't in the format you expected.

scenes.title: Ask for JSON
scenes.code:
response_format:
  { type: 'json_object' }

keys: category, urgent,
      summary, reply
scenes.say: Ask the model for JSON with fixed keys: category, urgent, summary and reply.
scenes.caption: Ask for JSON with fixed keys

scenes.title: Parse safely
scenes.say: Then parse it inside a try block. If anything is off, use a polite fallback reply, so the patient still hears back.
scenes.caption: try/catch + a polite fallback

scenes.sub: Clinic enquiry AI triage: workflow, setup guide and website form.
scenes.small: Works with n8n Cloud or self-hosted, and any OpenAI-compatible AI.
scenes.say: Want the free workflow? Check the link in my bio, or send me a message with the word flow.

post.caption:
Two habits that stop AI workflows from breaking:
1. Ask for JSON with fixed keys (category, urgent, summary, reply)
2. Parse inside try/catch and fall back to a polite default reply

The patient always hears back, even when the model misbehaves.
